Home › What We Buy › Sell Broken Gold

Damage Does Not Reduce Gold Content

A broken chain contains exactly as much gold as it did the day before it broke. At Bharat Gold Buyer, broken gold is paid by tested purity and weight — the same formula as intact jewellery — so damage does not reduce your payout.

Single earrings, odd studs and unmatched pieces are accepted and valued on their own weight and purity. If a stone has fallen out of a broken ring, that simply means less non-gold material in the piece; any set diamonds are still evaluated separately.

Testing on the German Karat Meter is free and non-destructive, and payment is made in the same visit once you accept.

What We Accept

  • Broken chains, bangles and bracelets

  • Damaged rings and pendants
  • Pieces with missing stones
How It Works

How to Sell Your Gold in 3 Easy Steps

1

Visit Our Branch

Bring your gold, silver or diamond items and one valid photo ID to our South Extension branch — 1515, Upper Ground Floor, Wazir Nagar, South Extension Part I, Kotla Mubarakpur, New Delhi 110003. No appointment needed.

2

Get Your Gold Evaluated

We test purity on the German Karat Meter in front of you, weigh the item at the counter, and give you a fair, transparent price at the day's market rate — the full calculation explained.

3

Receive Instant Payment

Accept our offer and get paid in the same visit via cash, cheque or bank transfer, with a proper receipt. If you don't accept, you take your items back — free, no obligation.
